description: The modern Identity Security solution for the modern enterprises. description: Nearly every major breach of recent years traces back to identity, and with agentic identities arriving at 100x the scale of the human workforce, legacy platforms won't hold. NewCore rebuilds the identity platform from the core as security-first infrastructure, not the weakest link in the enterprise cyber kill-chain. With token theft prevention, device-bound passkeys, next-generation MFA, and just-in-time agentic controls, NewCore lets enterprises embrace the agentic future without inheriting its risk. ‍

description: Keeping APIs out of the headlines. description: Non-Human Identity Management. Oasis created the first enterprise platform purpose-built to address the security and operational challenges of Non-human Identities. With 50x more non-human identities than human identities, ungoverned and uncontrolled, one of the largest attack surfaces has emerged. Danny, Amit and team Oasis solve the lifecycle deficiency, simply.
